name: Google TPU v6e: 918 BF16 TFLOPS per chip
methodology: Vendor-published per-chip specification. Single TensorCore with 2 MXUs (256x256 each). 32 GB HBM at 1638 GB/s. 256-chip pod on 2D torus with ICI 800 GB/s bidirectional per chip.
notes:
Vendor-published peak compute specification. The 918 TFLOPS is the theoretical BF16 peak per chip. No inference throughput (tokens/sec) is published by Google for TPU v6e. Google publishes no MFU or inference benchmark figures for TPU. The INT8 figure is 1836 TOPS (2x BF16).
